title: Japanese Chicken Skewers with Crispy Ultra Topping
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring juicy chicken skewers glazed with a sweet and savory sauce, topped with crispy ultra crumbs.
instructions: Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, soy sauce, honey, ginger, and sesame oil.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the chicken.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the chicken is cooking, heat the sesame oil in a small pan over medium heat.
Add the ultra crumbs and cook until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the grill and brush with the crispy ultra crumbs.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve immediately.
